description: A small cluster of gently raised, rectilinear platforms (approx. 30–60 m across) arranged in a loose grid, visible as subtle positive‐relief blocks in the hillshade and concave‐plan curvature, with corresponding lower NIR reflectance (moisture retention) and faint soil‐darkening in the true‐color image. These features sit off modern roads and align with known Terra Preta zones.

A linear concave trace, ~300 m long and aligned N–S, showing a shallow channel in the DTM derivatives. It corresponds to a narrow band of higher moisture stress on the NIR band and is unlinked to any OpenStreetMap roadway, suggesting a buried canal or drainage ditch.
